marta: I'm on deploy. I'll kick off at :00. I'll monitor smoke checks.
raj: Oncall here — I can watch metrics and take rollback if needed. Alert policy set.
tina: Can we confirm rollback steps? last time we did `kubectl rollout undo deployment/service-x --to-revision=3` — is that still valid?
samir: Yes. Updated runbook v2: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/deploys/service-x
samir: Rollback quick commands:
```
# rollback to last known good
kubectl rollout undo deployment/service-x
# or specific revision
kubectl rollout undo deployment/service-x --to-revision=3
```

- health endpoints 200
- p50/p95 token latency within SLO
- error rate <0.1%
- no regen rate spike
alex: Add: validate KV cache warmup (prefix hit rate > 80%)
deploy-bot: Scheduled deploy for service-x by marta at 2024-10-05T21:00Z. CI artifacts: build-550
marta: Starting canary (10% traffic). Will post results in 10m.
marta: Canary looks clean. p95 180ms, errors 0.02%. Proceeding to 100% in 2m.
raj: +1. Metrics okay from infra side. Ready to abort if spike.
tina: Confirmed rollback trigger conditions: 1) error rate >0.5% for 5m, 2) p95 > 800ms for 3m, 3) consumer queue lag > 2x baseline. If any, @marta roll back immediately.

alex: Thanks — I'm on standby for coordination. :thumbsup:
